$comment: The builder image's lock (ADR-0001 decision 9), written by `bun run builder:lock`, never by hand. `image` is the published image by tag, `digest` and `id` what the registry stored it at and the image id a pull gives (null: not published yet), and `contentSha256` the content of builder/ (every file but this one) it was built from. The gate pulls the image by digest when builder/ still has that content, and builds it from builder/ otherwise; a release requires the published image.
